title: Best Mouse Skates (2026)
summary: Mouse skates improve glide and reduce friction on mousepads.
method: Products were chosen from the RAWM shop listings (source 1) that specifically name mouse skates. Preference was given to items mentioned in multiple listings.
assumptions: No price comparisons were made beyond the listed sale prices; all picks are assumed to be in stock.

products.name: PTFE Mouse Feet for Leviathan V4 White
why: The RAWM listing shows this kit as a direct replacement for the Leviathan V4 mouse. It is made of PTFE, a low‑friction material that improves glide.
The sale price is $3.99, down from a regular $9.99, indicating a strong discount.
products.desc: A set of PTFE mouse feet designed for the Leviathan V4. They replace the stock pads and provide smoother movement. No other materials are included.
products.benefit: Picture a gamer swapping out the stock pads on a Leviathan V4 and feeling the mouse glide effortlessly across the pad. The PTFE surface reduces friction and noise, giving a smoother feel than the original pads. It is the only Leviathan‑specific kit in this guide, so it wins on exact fit. The catch: only a white color option is offered.
cons: May wear faster than metal pads
products.best_for: Leviathan V4 owners seeking smoother glide
products.skip_if: You already have high‑quality glass pads

products.name: PTFE Mouse Feet for ES21PRO White
why: Listed on RAWM as a replacement kit for the ES21PRO mouse. It uses the same PTFE material for low friction.
The sale price matches the Leviathan kit at $3.99, also reduced from $9.99.
products.desc: PTFE mouse feet made for the ES21PRO model. They replace the original pads and improve glide. No additional accessories are included.
products.benefit: Picture a user of an ES21PRO swapping the stock pads for these PTFE feet and noticing quieter, smoother movement. The low‑friction PTFE gives better glide than the stock pads and costs the same as the Leviathan kit. It is the cheapest PTFE option for this specific mouse in the guide. The catch: only available in white.

products.name: PTFE Mouse Feet for SH01 SH01PRO SH01S Black
why: RAWM lists this kit as compatible with three SH01 series mice, offering versatility.
It shares the same PTFE material and $3.99 sale price as the other kits.
products.desc: A PTFE mouse feet set that fits SH01, SH01PRO, and SH01S models. It replaces the original pads and provides smoother glide. No extra colors are supplied.
products.benefit: Picture a user with any SH01 series mouse installing these black PTFE feet and getting quieter, smoother tracking across any pad. The kit works for three models, making it the most versatile PTFE option here. It matches the low price of the other kits. The catch: only black color is offered.
products.best_for: Owners of SH01 series mice seeking a budget upgrade

products.name: PTFE Mouse Feet for ES21PRO White (Second Listing)
why: The RAWM shop shows the same ES21PRO kit twice, indicating high availability.
Both entries list the same $3.99 sale price.
products.desc: Same PTFE mouse feet for the ES21PRO as the earlier entry. Replaces stock pads for smoother glide. No extra items included.
products.benefit: Picture a buyer seeing two identical listings and choosing the one with better shipping. The PTFE material gives the same glide benefit as the first ES21PRO entry, and the price remains $3.99. The catch: it is a duplicate, offering no new features.
pros: Same low friction as other PTFE kits
products.best_for: ES21PRO owners who want any cheap PTFE upgrade
products.skip_if: You already have the first ES21PRO kit

verdict.pick: PTFE Mouse Feet for Leviathan V4 White
verdict.line: Ideal for Leviathan V4 owners who want smoother, quieter movement. It uses PTFE for low friction and is cheap, but the only downside is limited color choice.
also: PTFE Mouse Feet for ES21PRO White
